name: memes
description: A meme search engine over the sites that actually have the memes. One query fans out to Reddit's meme subreddits (public JSON), Imgflip's template list, Know Your Meme's encyclopedia (scraped) and 9GAG, comes back as one deduplicated, score-ranked list, and lands in a console that is a search box and a wall of memes. Trending, random and template lookup on top. No API keys anywhere; a source that blocks this box reports itself in `errors` and the rest still answer.

endpoints./info: Null call — what this module is and what it exposes
endpoints./health: Liveness — no network calls, answers even when every source is down
endpoints./sources: The sites this engine reaches and how it reaches each one
endpoints./search: Search every meme site at once, or one (q, source=all|reddit|imgflip|knowyourmeme|ninegag, limit, nsfw)
endpoints./trending: What is hot right now — Reddit's and 9GAG's hot feeds, merged (limit, nsfw)
endpoints./random: One meme, at random, off the top of the hot feeds
endpoints./templates: Imgflip's blank canvases — the templates memes get captioned from (q, limit)

sources.reddit: public JSON — search + hot across r/memes, r/dankmemes, r/me_irl and five more
sources.imgflip: api.imgflip.com/get_memes — the ~100 most-captioned templates, cached an hour
sources.knowyourmeme: search page HTML, scraped — the encyclopedia, not the firehose
